opening.argument: The video describes an ordinary cashback-and-rewards process: viewers create a CashKaro account, earn rewards through shopping, and convert accumulated rewards into an Amazon gift card. The speaker explains that the card becomes available after rewards reach a stated threshold, grounding the benefit in shopping and reward redemption rather than a payment-for-access or recruitment-dependent earnings scheme. A separate monthly giveaway asks viewers to comment, alongside requests to like and subscribe. The supplied evidence shows no deceptive identity request, and establishes no losses, deceptive outcome, or other claim beyond these promotions.
